text:
Samir: Quick follow-up from last night's EU switch — want to lock owners, due dates, and recurrence fixes before the next game day.

Priya: Uploaded the postmortem notes here: https://redwood.internal/notes/eu-switch-2026. Key repeated pattern: AS-path leakage during switchback.

Liwei: I'll own the routing script rework. ETA end of next week (2026-04-04). Will post a PR and link tests.

Casey: Can you add a BGP regression test that simulates route churn? I can pair on the automation.

Liwei: Yep — pairing with @Casey. CI job to simulate route flap + verify traffic steering.

Jenna: Backup validation note: snapshot verification failed on one host during restore. I'll triage and add a pre-game snapshot check to the runbook. Target 2026-03-30.

Alex: I'll run a restore runbook dry-run in staging on Tue. Need a 2-hour slot.

Samir: Scheduler ask: ops can we block Tue 09:00-11:00 UTC for the dry-run? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Calendar: 2-hour slot created on 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC — invites sent to @oncall, Casey, Liwei, Jenna.

infra-bot: Incident 2026-03-30-EU-switch: status -> closed. Follow-ups created: 6.

Priya: Quick action-item list (owners + due dates) — putting the canonical list here so we can track in GH Projects and the follow-up board:

```
AI-001 | Routing script rework                    | owner: Liwei  | due: 2026-04-04
AI-002 | BGP regression CI job                    | owner: Casey  | due: 2026-04-01
AI-003 | Snapshot pre-check hook                  | owner: Jenna  | due: 2026-03-30
AI-004 | Restore runbook dry-run + notes          | owner: Alex   | due: 2026-03-31
AI-005 | Prefix-based traffic steering doc        | owner: Samir  | due: 2026-04-07
AI-006 | Game-day runbook checklist additions     | owner: Priya  | due: 2026-03-29
```

Casey: I'll open GH issues for AI-002 and attach the test harness + matrix.

Liwei: PR draft will land this week; will request review from @Alex and @Priya.

Jenna: Confirmed root cause for snapshot verify: race in the uploader after volume attachment. I'll add a short fix + release note; will also add a pre-check script to fail fast.

Samir: Also, let's tag recurring incidents so we can spot patterns: add label "failover-patterns" to incidents and enable weekly digest to infra channel.

Priya: Will add PagerDuty scheduled task to create weekly digest and add the label to past 30 days' incidents. Cadence: weekly.

Casey: One more ask — warm-standby snapshot in another region would reduce restore time. Need a rough cost estimate before proposing to finance.

Alex: I'll run a cost model and ping finance. Expect a note by EOD Fri.

Samir: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with the AI list and owners. We'll review progress next Thursday during ops sync.

Casey: 👍

Priya: LGTM, thanks everyone.

infra-bot: Follow-up checklist updated in incident tracker: 6 open AIs.

Samir: Closing this thread for now — ping if blockers pop up.
